periods.time: Tokyo shelter during the first night of the war
periods.label: 支持母亲的小鸣

relationships.kurono-shinguji: Mother whom she admires and wants to cheer for.
relationships.takumi-shinguji: Father who protects and encourages her in the shelter.

periods.summary: Mei reunites with Kurono in the shelter after the first day of battle and asks whether her mother is truly strong. Although frightened, she has endured the evacuation without crying in front of others. Her wish to see and cheer for Kurono's strength, combined with Takumi's words, helps Kurono realize that family can be a source of courage rather than a burden.

key_events.summary: Gives Kurono emotional support before the second US assault.
